purpose: Phase 5 bounded DBLP subset: works of common-name seed authors plus one hop of their coauthors, extracted from a local official dump. OpenAlex, Crossref and ORCID only enrich; they never filter DBLP works.
per_seed_name_definition: caps.per_seed_name bounds, for each seed name, the works in the subset file that mention that name (homonym suffix ignored). A work with two seed names counts once for each; coauthor-pass works mention no seed name and count for none. The extractor admits works in smallest SHA-256(salt|key) order, skipping any that would push a name over the cap; the receipt and the validator count with the same function.
